summary: Apply EU AI Act duties to staff literacy, risk screening, and deployer controls. Explore the practical course outline and enrol your team.
lede: AI compliance and literacy training helps compliance, HR, IT, legal and operational teams turn applicable requirements into workplace procedures. Participants practise identifying AI systems and roles, screening prohibited and high-risk uses, and documenting staff instruction, human oversight and governance evidence. Exercises include building an AI inventory, risk-classification matrix, deployer checklist and records index, while complex legal interpretation is covered at overview level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who select, procure, oversee, or use AI systems and need to connect the EU AI Act’s requirements to their daily responsibilities.
modules: EU AI Act Scope and Roles
prerequisites: No coding is required. Familiarity with AI systems your organization uses, procures, or oversees will help you apply the exercises; you may use a permitted workplace example or the course scenarios.
